'''Junior''' was the name of a [[Rancor/Legends|Rancor]] kept in the pens of the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]] on [[Zakuul]] during the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]]. After the Eternal Empress [[Vaylin]]'s speech was interrupted by the arrival of the [[Alliance Commander]] and the former Emperor [[Arcann]], [[Beastmaster/Legends|Beast master]] [[Oleg (Zakuul)|Oleg]] released Junior to deal with the captured Zakuulan rebels. However, the Alliance Commander and [[Theron Shan]] managed to get into the beast den and time and killed Junior before he could harm [[Indo Zal]] and the other rebels.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Junior appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during '''"Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw."'''
